subject: general
question: Which of the following soil types is rich in soil nutrients such as calcium carbonate, magnesium, potash and lime?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Black soil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Black soil is also known as **Regur soil** and is predominantly found in the Deccan Plateau region including Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• This soil is **rich in soil nutrients** such as calcium carbonate, magnesium, potash, and lime which make it highly fertile and suitable for growing cotton and other crops.
 
• The soil has a high **clay content**, which helps in retaining moisture, making it ideal for dry farming.
 
• Black soil is known for its **dark color** which is attributed to the presence of various iron compounds and organic matter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laterite Soil**

 
 
• Laterite soil is rich in iron and aluminum but generally poor in nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium.
 
• This soil is typically found in areas with high temperatures and heavy rainfall, such as the Western Ghats and parts of Odisha, Karnataka, and Kerala.
 
• It is characterized by its reddish color due to the high iron oxide content.
 
• Laterite soil is used for plantation crops like tea, coffee, rubber, and cashew nuts.
 
 
 
• **Yellow Soil**
 
 
• Yellow soil is derived from the weathering of ancient crystalline rocks and is found in areas with high rainfall.
 
• The yellow color is due to the presence of hydrated iron oxides.
 
• This soil is generally poor in organic matter, nitrogen, and phosphorus but is suitable for growing rice, millets, and pulses.
 
 
 
• **Red Soil**
 
 
• Red soil is rich in iron oxide, which gives it its characteristic red color.
 
• It is found in areas of low rainfall and is poor in nitrogen, phosphorus, and humus but rich in potassium.
 
• Red soil is suitable for growing crops like cotton, wheat, pulses, tobacco, and oilseeds.
